ios.desc:
SnapKeeps

Hold memories briefly. Let go with grace.

SnapKeeps is a minimal photo keeper that stores your camera captures, screenshots, and photos for a limited time only. Perfect for saving work schedules, quick notes, hotel room numbers, or anything you don’t need forever.
•Set custom retention: 12 hours, 1 day, up to 30 days
•Automatically deletes expired images
•Capture with camera or import from Photos
•Built-in OCR extracts text instantly
•Keeps your main album clean and uncluttered
•Gentle progress bar shows time remaining
•No cloud — everything stays local

Like petals falling with the wind, SnapKeeps believes not everything needs to last forever.
Save it. Use it. Let it go.

show_hn.title: Show HN: SnapKeeps(iOSApp)– A photo app that forgets for you

quotes.text:
Hi HN!

I built SnapKeeps, a minimalist iOS app that holds your photos and screenshots temporarily — then lets them go.

You can use it for:
– Saving quick notes, hotel room numbers, schedules
– OCR to extract text from screenshots
– Keeping your main album clean
– Letting go of unneeded images after 12h to 30d

No cloud. No account. Everything stays local.

This app is part of my personal project, OS Yamato, a suite of tools exploring ephemeral data and calm UX.

If you have any feedback or ideas, I’d love to hear from you — feel free to reply here or reach out!
